verdict.rationale: Radar is a fraud rules engine, so backtesting rules against historical traffic is a fair question for this product. The evidence covers creating custom rules, fraud-trend analytics and sandbox test cards. None of it shows replaying a draft rule against past payments to see what it would have blocked, flagged or cost. Fraud insights only shows trends and attribute combinations, not a rule simulation, and the test cards produce synthetic sandbox charges rather than historical traffic.
